notes.title: ENDLESS MODE is here! Update YUKI now FOR FREE!
notes.notes:
Hi, Space Rangers!
We are happy to announce that YUKI just got one of the best updates ever, and best of all, totally free! 

On Endless Mode you'll be able to beat more and more waves of enemies as the game gets harder and harder!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/c8610ff71c6e994fa631fb388080eb2675107153.gif

Another cool feature that this update brings to the game is the leaderboard! 
You'll be able to challenge yourself and your friends to see who gets the best score!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/ca621495e2920a3521f8523769e53d44035ea5f0.gif

It's time for some endless fun!
Update your game now!

We are always getting feedback and suggestions from our awesome community of players. Feel free to join our discord server to have a good chat, not to mention having access to some YUKI-related freebies and lore material ;)
https://discord.gg/AZ8fjvuzhc

ENDLESS MODE IS HERE!
FREE UPDATE

It's time for some endless fun!

notes.title: Angle correction + Difficulty Balance + Quality of Life UPDATE
notes.notes:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39076979/390f676a635735faf04e41330dba4fec1f05e566.png

Hi, Space Rangers!
We made some adjustments to YUKI! Nothing major, but since our community was asking for them we decided to implement them already so everyone could enjoy our game the best way possible :)

Bugfixes

 Angle Offset correction for Vive and Index controllers
 Fixed a rare bug where no powerup choice showed up in the power capsule during the run

Quality of Life adjustments

 Added a skip button to allow users to bypass the intro screens
 Minor balancing improvements


We are always getting feedback and suggestions from our awesome community of players. Feel free to join our discord server to have a good chat, not to mention having access to some YUKI-related freebies and lore material ;)
https://discord.gg/AZ8fjvuzhc
